设 a_n 为一等差数列的第 n 项。若 a_{18}=26 及 a_{23}=61，则下列何者正确？
I. a_{14}<0
II. a_{1}-a_{2}<0
III. a_{1}+a_{2}+a_{3}+⋯+a_{27}>0
A. 只有 I 及 II
B. 只有 I 及 III
C. 只有 II 及 III
D. I、II 及 III
reasoning: From a_{18}=a_1+17d=26 and a_{23}=a_1+22d=61, subtract to get 5d=35, so d=7. Then a_1=26-17*7=26-119=-93. Compute a_{14}=a_1+13d=-93+91=-2<0 (true). Also a_2=a_1+d=-93+7=-86, so a_1-a_2=-93-(-86)=-7<0 (true). The sum of the first 27 terms is S_{27}=27/2*(a_1+a_{27}) where a_{27}=a_1+26d=-93+182=89, giving S_{27}=27/2*(-4)=-54<0, so III is false. Therefore only statements I and II are correct, which corresponds to answer A.
